name: Esketamine (Spravato)
description: S form of ketamine, an NMDA receptor blocker, given as a nasal spray (Spravato)

note.text: Some maker-run trials met their main goal and some did not. The label says it has not been shown to prevent suicide.

bullets: **Label:** blocks the NMDA receptor, a receptor for glutamate
**Label:** how it eases depression is unknown
Used in a **certified health care setting**, with at least 2 hours of monitoring
Two TRANSFORM trials missed their main goal

practical.routes: Nasal spray, in a certified health care setting (label)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak 20 to 40 min; CYP2B6 and CYP3A4; about 48% bioavailable
practical.soldAs: Prescription nasal spray (Spravato) via REMS; Schedule III
practical.monitored: Sedation, dissociation, breathing, blood pressure for 2 h+

regulatory.text: Authorised 2019, with an SSRI or SNRI

references: JAMA Psychiatry, SUSTAIN-1 relapse prevention trial, Sep 2019
